## Climate  (BIO2 — Mean diurnal range BIO8 — Mean temperature of wettest quarter BIO9 — Mean temperature of driest quarter BIO15 — Precipitation seasonality BIO18 — Precipitation of warmest quarter)
```{r}
library(sf); library(terra); library(dplyr); library(predicts)

## Paths and Illinois counties
root <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois"

il_sf <- st_read("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Bayesian Spatial Modeling (Illinois)/Illinois Shape File/Shape file of interest/IL_BNDY_County_Py.shp", quiet=TRUE) %>%
  select(COUNTY_NAM) %>% st_make_valid() %>% st_transform(4326)

il_v <- vect(il_sf)

## Download/cache climate
base_url <- "https://geodata.ucdavis.edu/climate/worldclim/2_1/hist/cts4.09"
cache <- file.path(root, "Data/Climate_CRU_TS_4.09")
dir.create(cache, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
options(timeout=3600)

get_year <- function(variable, year) {
  stem <- paste0("wc2.1_cruts4.09_2.5m_", variable, "_2020-2024")
  folder <- file.path(cache, stem)
  zipfile <- file.path(cache, paste0(stem, ".zip"))

  tif <- if(dir.exists(folder)) list.files(folder, "\\.tif$", recursive=TRUE, full.names=TRUE) else character()

  if(length(tif) != 60) {
    if(!file.exists(zipfile))
      download.file(paste0(base_url,"/",basename(zipfile)), zipfile, mode="wb")

    dir.create(folder, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
    unzip(zipfile, exdir=folder)
    tif <- list.files(folder, "\\.tif$", recursive=TRUE, full.names=TRUE)
  }

  f <- tif[grepl(paste0(year,"[-_.](0?[1-9]|1[0-2])\\.tif$"), basename(tif))]
  m <- as.integer(sub(paste0(".*",year,"[-_.]([0-9]{1,2})\\.tif$"), "\\1", basename(f)))

  x <- rast(f[order(m)])
  mask(crop(x, il_v), il_v)
}

## Progress bar: 12 steps total
# 3 years × 4 main steps
pb <- txtProgressBar(min=0, max=12, style=3)
step <- 0

progress <- function(msg) {
  step <<- step + 1
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, step)
  cat(sprintf("\n%.1f%% completed | %s\n", 100*step/12, msg))
}

## Calculate BIO variables
bio_annual <- lapply(2022:2024, function(y) {

  cat("\nProcessing year:", y, "\n")

  prec <- get_year("prec", y)
  progress(paste(y, "precipitation loaded"))

  tmin <- get_year("tmin", y)
  progress(paste(y, "minimum temperature loaded"))

  tmax <- get_year("tmax", y)
  progress(paste(y, "maximum temperature loaded"))

  bio <- predicts::bcvars(prec=prec, tmin=tmin, tmax=tmax)

  x <- bio[[c(2,8,9,15,18)]]
  names(x) <- c("BIO2","BIO8","BIO9","BIO15","BIO18")

  z <- terra::extract(x, il_v, fun=mean, na.rm=TRUE)

  progress(paste(y, "county extraction completed"))

  data.frame(COUNTY_NAM=il_sf$COUNTY_NAM, Year=y, z[,-1])
}) %>% bind_rows()

close(pb)
cat("\nClimate extraction completed: 100%\n")

## Average 2022–2024
climate <- bio_annual %>%
  group_by(COUNTY_NAM) %>%
  summarise(across(c(BIO2,BIO8,BIO9,BIO15,BIO18), ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE)), .groups="drop") %>%
  arrange(COUNTY_NAM)

stopifnot(nrow(climate)==102, !anyNA(climate))

print(climate, n=102)
summary(climate)

## Save
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Data/Faetures"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)

write.csv(
  climate,
  file.path(out_dir, "climate_BIO_2022_2024.csv"),
  row.names=FALSE
)

cat("\nSaved:", file.path(out_dir, "climate_BIO_2022_2024.csv"), "\n")

```


## Landscape (forest %, wetland %, forest edge density)
```{r}
library(sf); library(terra); library(dplyr)
library(exactextractr); library(landscapemetrics); library(raster); library(curl)

## Paths
root <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois"
shp_path <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Bayesian Spatial Modeling (Illinois)/Illinois Shape File/Shape file of interest/IL_BNDY_County_Py.shp"

il_sf <- sf::st_read(shp_path, quiet=TRUE) %>% dplyr::select(COUNTY_NAM) %>% sf::st_make_valid()
stopifnot(nrow(il_sf)==102)

years <- 2022:2024
cache <- file.path(root,"Data/Annual_NLCD")
dir.create(cache, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)

## Progress
total_steps <- length(years)*105
pb <- txtProgressBar(min=0,max=total_steps,style=3); step <- 0
progress <- function(msg=NULL) {
  step <<- step+1; setTxtProgressBar(pb,step)
  if(!is.null(msg)) cat(sprintf("\n%.1f%% completed | %s\n",100*step/total_steps,msg))
}

## Download/load Annual NLCD
get_nlcd <- function(y) {
  stem <- paste0("Annual_NLCD_LndCov_",y,"_CU_C1V1")
  zipfile <- file.path(cache,paste0(stem,".zip"))
  tiffile <- file.path(cache,paste0(stem,".tif"))
  url <- paste0("https://www.mrlc.gov/downloads/sciweb1/shared/mrlc/data-bundles/",stem,".zip")

  if(!file.exists(tiffile)) {
    if(!file.exists(zipfile)) {
      cat("\nDownloading NLCD",y,"...\n")
      curl::curl_download(url,zipfile,quiet=FALSE)
    }
    cat("\nExtracting NLCD",y,"...\n")
    unzip(zipfile,files=paste0(stem,".tif"),exdir=cache)
  }

  terra::rast(tiffile)
}

## Extract 2022–2024
land_annual <- lapply(years,function(y) {

  cat("\nProcessing Annual NLCD",y,"\n")
  nlcd <- get_nlcd(y)
  progress(paste(y,"NLCD loaded"))

  il_y <- sf::st_transform(il_sf,terra::crs(nlcd))
  nlcd_r <- raster::raster(nlcd)

  pct <- function(codes) exactextractr::exact_extract(
    nlcd_r,il_y,function(values,frac) {
      ok <- !is.na(values)
      100*sum(frac[ok & values %in% codes],na.rm=TRUE)/sum(frac[ok],na.rm=TRUE)
    },progress=FALSE)

  forest_pct <- pct(c(41,42,43))
  progress(paste(y,"forest cover extracted"))

  wetland_pct <- pct(c(90,95))
  progress(paste(y,"wetland cover extracted"))

  edge <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(il_y)),function(i) {
    county <- terra::vect(il_y[i,])
    r <- terra::mask(terra::crop(nlcd,county),county)
    forest <- r %in% c(41,42,43)

    m <- landscapemetrics::calculate_lsm(
      forest,what="lsm_c_ed",directions=8,verbose=FALSE
    ) %>% dplyr::filter(class==1)

    progress(if(i%%10==0 || i==102) paste(y,"edge density:",i,"/ 102 counties") else NULL)
    if(nrow(m)==0) NA_real_ else m$value[1]
  })

  data.frame(COUNTY_NAM=il_y$COUNTY_NAM,Year=y,
             Forest_pct=forest_pct,Wetland_pct=wetland_pct,
             Forest_edge_density=edge)
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

close(pb)
cat("\n100% completed | Landscape extraction finished\n")

## Average 2022–2024
landscape <- land_annual %>%
  group_by(COUNTY_NAM) %>%
  summarise(across(c(Forest_pct,Wetland_pct,Forest_edge_density),
                   ~mean(.x,na.rm=TRUE)),.groups="drop") %>%
  arrange(COUNTY_NAM)

stopifnot(nrow(landscape)==102,!anyNA(landscape))
print(landscape,n=102)
summary(landscape)

## Save
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Data/Faetures"
dir.create(out_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)

write.csv(landscape,file.path(out_dir,"landscape_2022_2024.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
cat("\nSaved:",file.path(out_dir,"landscape_2022_2024.csv"),"\n")
```



## Deer habiate suitability index
```{r}
library(sf); library(terra); library(dplyr); library(exactextractr)

## Paths and Illinois counties
root <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois"

shp_path <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Bayesian Spatial Modeling (Illinois)/Illinois Shape File/Shape file of interest/IL_BNDY_County_Py.shp"

deer_path <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Tick Passive Survillance/Data/Deer Habitate Data (Illinois)/Deer Habitat Rasters/Deer_Habitat_2022.tif"

il_sf <- sf::st_read(shp_path, quiet=TRUE) %>% dplyr::select(COUNTY_NAM) %>% sf::st_make_valid()
deer_r <- terra::rast(deer_path)
il_deer <- sf::st_transform(il_sf, terra::crs(deer_r))

## Check raster scale
cat("25% completed | Raster loaded\n")
print(terra::global(deer_r, c("min","max"), na.rm=TRUE))

## Extract county mean deer habitat suitability
cat("50% completed | Extracting county means\n")

Deer_suitability <- exactextractr::exact_extract(
  deer_r, il_deer, "mean", progress=TRUE
)

deer <- data.frame(
  COUNTY_NAM=il_deer$COUNTY_NAM,
  Deer_suitability=Deer_suitability
) %>% arrange(COUNTY_NAM)

cat("75% completed | Checking output\n")

stopifnot(nrow(deer)==102, !anyDuplicated(deer$COUNTY_NAM), !anyNA(deer$Deer_suitability))
print(deer, n=102)
summary(deer$Deer_suitability)

## Save
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Data/Faetures"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)

write.csv(deer, file.path(out_dir,"deer_habitat_2022.csv"), row.names=FALSE)

cat("100% completed | Saved deer_habitat_2022.csv\n")
```



##Combine all feature
```{r}
library(dplyr)

## Load feature files
feat_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Data/Faetures"

climate <- read.csv(file.path(feat_dir, "climate_BIO_2022_2024.csv"))
landscape <- read.csv(file.path(feat_dir, "landscape_2022_2024.csv"))
deer <- read.csv(file.path(feat_dir, "deer_habitat_2022.csv"))

## Combine all features
features <- climate %>%
  left_join(landscape, by="COUNTY_NAM") %>%
  left_join(deer, by="COUNTY_NAM") %>%
  arrange(COUNTY_NAM)

## Checks
stopifnot(nrow(features)==102, !anyDuplicated(features$COUNTY_NAM))
cat("Counties:", nrow(features), "\n")
cat("Missing values:", sum(is.na(features)), "\n")

print(features, n=102)
summary(features)

## Save
feat_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Data/Faetures"

write.csv(
  features,
  file.path(feat_dir, "ALL FEATURES COMBINED.csv"),
  row.names=FALSE
)

cat("\nSaved:", file.path(feat_dir, "ALL FEATURES COMBINED.csv"), "\n")

```
